evidence.source: 中央研究院漢字字形演變資料庫
evidence.text: The database interprets the seal-script graph as 人 + 至, with 人 graphically reinterpreted as 刀, which it then treats as the phonetic component; it calls 至 semantic and 刀 phonetic. This is the database’s account, not independently demonstrated chronology.
evidence.title: 漢字「到」：字形演變

evidence.source: 國學大師 character evolution database
evidence.text: Lists forms labeled bronze, Warring States, seal, clerical, and regular script. It identifies bronze examples including 伯到尊 and 伯到簋, and Qin slip examples 睡·雜28 and 睡·秦5. Its account analyzes forms from bronze through regular script as 至 semantic + 刀 phonetic. The page’s captions and interpretations are reported, not independent proof of the glyphs’ identity or chronology.
evidence.title: 到字形演变字源

evidence.field: Shuowen analysis, readings, senses, cited examples, and paleographic access
evidence.text: Records the Shuowen analysis 至也。从至，刀聲, fanqie 都悼切, and Mandarin dào. It cites the received 詩經·大雅·韓奕 phrase 靡國不到 for ‘reach/arrive’, plus examples for ‘thorough’ and ‘go to’. Several paleographic reference collections on the page are marked unavailable; this page therefore does not verify those glyphs.
evidence.title: A00348 到 — Dictionary of Chinese Character Variants

evidence.field: formation, cited senses, and source chronology limits
evidence.text: Analyzes 到 as 至 semantic + 刀 phonetic and gives ‘come to, arrive’ as the basic sense. It lists citations for ‘go’, ‘thorough/careful’, ‘deceive’, and ‘say/state’ from 東觀漢記, 後漢書, 史記, and a Jin text. Those citations identify textual sources but do not establish dates of the wording or explain the semantic links.
evidence.title: 漢語多功能字庫

evidence.field: Old Chinese and Middle Chinese reconstructions for 刀 and 到
evidence.text: In the authors’ 2014 Baxter–Sagart dataset, 刀 dāo has Middle Chinese taw and Old Chinese *C.tˤaw (‘knife’); 到 dào has Middle Chinese tawH and Old Chinese *tˤaw[k]-s (‘arrive’). These forms support a close sound relationship within this reconstruction system, while also distinguishing the words’ tone category and reconstructed morphology. The data do not establish the historical name or pronunciation of an object depicted by 刀.
evidence.title: Baxter-Sagart Old Chinese reconstruction, version 1.1 (20 September 2014)

evidence.field: history of 到 constructions and early cited example
evidence.text: The study treats 到 as an independent verb meaning ‘arrive/reach’ in pre-Qin usage and cites 詩經·韓奕 蹶父孔武，靡國不到. It describes later constructional developments separately, including increasing use after motion verbs in the Western Han and grammaticalization in later periods. This is the author’s account of textual evidence, not a date for the poem’s composition or the earliest surviving witness.
evidence.title: 試論粤方言「V到C」程度述補結構的歷史來源

evidence.field: candidate bronze glyph description and license evidence
evidence.text: Search result describes 到-bronze.svg as a Western Zhou bronze-script depiction of 到. The Commons file description could not be opened in this session, so its file-specific license, source details, and actual direct image URL were not independently verified; it is not proposed as a glyph candidate.
evidence.title: File:到-bronze.svg

evidence.source: Wikimedia Commons via German Wikibooks file description
evidence.field: candidate seal glyph’s provenance and reuse rights
evidence.text: The accessible search result describes 到-seal.svg as a vector depiction of the character in Shuowen seal-script style, identifies a related Hanziyuan image reference s08674, and reports a public-domain claim while also mentioning courtesy, permission, and copyright from Richard Sears’s website. Because the page did not open and the rights wording is mixed, permission and direct-image provenance remain unresolved; the file is not proposed as a reusable candidate.
evidence.title: Datei:到-seal.svg

search_audit.outcome: Opened Academia Sinica and Guoxuedashi pages for their contents. Found competing seal-form analysis and later 至+刀 account. Commons category opened but did not establish a candidate.

search_audit.outcome: Opened Baxter–Sagart project page and consulted its PDF dataset returned in search results. Verified same-system forms for 刀 and 到.

search_audit.outcome: Search identified bronze and seal candidates, but direct Commons file opens failed with cache-miss errors. search_audit.outcome: Opened the Kyushu University study and Taiwan MOE dictionary. Verified an early received-poem example is cited and saw a scholarly account of later constructional development. The searched Shidianguji chapter did not open; no composition date inferred.

gaps: The seal-form account from Academia Sinica (人 + 至, with 人 reinterpreted as phonetic 刀) conflicts with the standard 至 + 刀 analysis reported by Shuowen and several databases. The actual graphic transition, chronology, and possibility of graphic corruption remain unresolved.

No inspected primary image or accessible paleographic catalog established an oracle-bone form or the earliest securely dated inscription of 到. Database labels identify bronze examples, but the image content was not inspected in this research stage.

The received 詩經·韓奕 phrase is cited as an early textual use, but its composition and transmission dates are not established by the inspected sources. The Analects citation and its precise textual witness were not reverified in this stage.

The dictionary’s additional senses ‘go’, ‘thorough/careful’, ‘deceive’, and ‘say/state’ have cited examples, but their respective dates and semantic pathways are not adequately established by the inspected sources. The independent linguistic study does describe later constructional developments for 到 as a verb and complement.

刀~到 phonetic correspondence is independently supported within the Baxter–Sagart reconstruction system, and 至 is identified as semantic in multiple dictionary accounts. 刀’s pictorial/object referent and the ultimate etymology or original pronunciation of the spoken word 刀 do not establish the phonetic role and are not needed for this compound analysis.

Commons returned search descriptions for 到 historical-style files, but relevant image description pages failed to open. File-specific direct image URLs and reuse rights were not verified; no image is included.

limitations.text: No glyph candidate met this stage’s requirement for an inspected description/source page with verified direct image URL and reuse provenance. Commons search results identified 到-bronze.svg (Western Zhou bronze-style redraw) and 到-seal.svg (Shuowen seal-style redraw), but attempted opens failed with cache-miss errors; their direct URLs and rights remain unresolved here.
